categories.main_business_segments: Halliburton operates through two primary business segments: Completion and Production, and Drilling and Evaluation. The Completion and Production segment provides cementing, stimulation, specialty chemicals, intervention, pressure control, artificial lift, and completion products and services. The Drilling and Evaluation segment offers field and reservoir modeling, drilling, fluids, evaluation, and precise wellbore placement solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Halliburton leverages advanced technologies such as digital and automation solutions, cloud-based software, artificial intelligence, and proprietary drilling and completion tools. The company is a leader in hydraulic fracturing, cementing, drilling fluids, and well intervention, and manufactures much of its own equipment to maintain flexibility and efficiency. R&D focuses on improving efficiency, emissions reduction, and developing environmentally friendly chemical and mechanical technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Halliburton's primary customers are major, national, and independent oil and natural gas producers worldwide. The company serves the upstream energy sector, supporting customers throughout the lifecycle of oil and gas reservoirs, from exploration and drilling to completion and production optimization.
categories.geographic_coverage: Halliburton operates in more than 70 countries, with business organized around four main regions: North America, Latin America, Europe/Africa/CIS, and Middle East/Asia. In 2024, 40% of revenue was from the United States, with no other country accounting for more than 10%. The company maintains a geographically diversified asset and workforce base.
categories.supply_chain_position: Halliburton is positioned as a diversified energy services provider, primarily serving the upstream segment of the oil and gas supply chain. The company delivers products and services that support exploration, drilling, well construction, completion, and production optimization, acting as a critical partner to oil and gas producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding international growth, especially in directional drilling, unconventionals, well intervention, and artificial lift; maximizing North American value through digital and electric fracturing technologies; and maintaining capital efficiency. Halliburton is investing in digital transformation, automation, emissions reduction, and energy transition initiatives such as carbon capture and geothermal, as well as supporting clean tech startups through Halliburton Labs.
categories.revenue_model: Halliburton generates revenue primarily through the sale of oilfield services and products, including both short-term service contracts and product sales. Revenue is recognized based on the transfer of control or customer benefit from services and products, with payment terms typically within 20 to 60 days. The company also offers software and integrated project management services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Halliburton is one of the world's largest diversified energy services companies, competing with numerous substantial global and regional players such as Schlumberger, Baker Hughes, and Weatherford. The company is recognized for its broad service portfolio, technological leadership, and strong presence in both North America and international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Halliburton reported $22.9 billion in revenue, flat compared to 2023, with operating income of $3.8 billion. The company maintains strong operating margins (20% in Completion and Production, 16% in Drilling and Evaluation) and robust cash flows, returning $1.6 billion to shareholders in 2024. International revenue grew 6% while North America declined 8%, reflecting a strategic shift toward international markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Halliburton emphasizes its ability to collaborate and engineer solutions that maximize asset value for customers, focusing on efficiency, increased recovery, and production maximization. The company differentiates itself through technology leadership, digital and automation capabilities, comprehensive service offerings, and a commitment to sustainability and emissions reduction, supporting customers through the entire reservoir lifecycle.
